card.name: Digits inside decimal and percent numbers
card.fires_on: A digit or decimal point partway through a multi-digit number, especially just before a 7, 67, or similar ending. It appears in percentages, dose tables, and infusion rates.

modes.label: Percent in adverse reaction text
modes.description: The leading digit of a percentage such as 67% in adverse reaction or incidence statements.

modes.label: Numbers in dosing tables
modes.description: A digit or decimal point inside a decimal value in dose or infusion-rate tables.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of numbers like 6.7 or 167, where the next digit is expected to be a 7.
